paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Mina; Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia, chapter 1, at the end of halakhah 4. See the entry Bina.[^1]

notes.text: סה״ד is read here as end of halakhah 4, following chapter 1. The named Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 1:4 has explicit Rabbi Ba bar Mina in its final segment. This supports the local contextual reading and title, while the supplied Abba bar Mina, named Ba bar Mina, and cross-reference Bina remain distinct forms. The earlier Seder HaDorot and end-of-entry interpretations are preserved in history rather than adopted; no printed-image or identity admission follows.
